title: Generate CONVENTIONS.md
dev_command: echo 'No dev server needed for task 0'

claude_code_command.loop_1: cat CONVENTIONS.md tasks/task0/task0.md | claude -p 'Read the task spec and CONVENTIONS.md above. Step 1: write tasks/task0/task0-assumptions.md listing every assumption before touching any file. Step 2: implement every file in allowed_paths. Step 3: write tasks/task0/task0-result.md (human-readable) and tasks/task0/task0-result.json (machine-readable) using the result schema in the pipeline spec.' --allowedTools 'Edit,Write,Bash,Read,Glob,Grep' --output-format text 2>&1 | tee tasks/task0/artifacts/logs/loop-1.txt
claude_code_command.loop_n: cat CONVENTIONS.md tasks/task0/task0.md tasks/task0/task0-assumptions.md tasks/task0/task0-result.md tasks/task0/task0-review-feedback.md | claude -p 'Read all context above including the review feedback. Fix every item in blocking_issues. Update tasks/task0/task0-result.md and tasks/task0/task0-result.json.' --allowedTools 'Edit,Write,Bash,Read,Glob,Grep' --output-format text 2>&1 | tee tasks/task0/artifacts/logs/loop-{ITERATION}.txt

codex_review_command: cat CONVENTIONS.md tasks/task0/task0.md tasks/task0/task0-result.md tasks/task0/artifacts/verify-output.txt | codex -p 'You are Codex reviewing a task implementation. Read the task spec (task0.md), what was built (task0-result.md), and the verify runner output above. Write tasks/task0/task0-review-feedback.md (human-readable notes) and tasks/task0/task0-review-feedback.json (machine-readable, strict schema). The json must contain: task_id, iteration, passed_review (bool), verify_exit_code (int), furthest_iteration (int), blocking_issues (array), non_blocking_notes (array), next_action (pass|retry|terminate).' 2>&1 | tee tasks/task0/artifacts/logs/codex-{ITERATION}.txt
